name: Mirueña de los Infanzones (Spain)
description: Red field with a compony border of red and white squares, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mirueña de los Infanzones (a tower, a bull and a church).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 31 January 1994 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 37 of 23 February 1994); the flag is rectangular of proportion 2 at the hoist to 3 in the fly, red with a compony orle of white and red and the municipal arms at the centre.
